test_is_available: test the is_available function to check if ITT feature is available
create_range_push: create an ITT range push with a descriptive ASCII message string
create_range_pop: create an ITT range pop to end the current nested range span
create_mark: create an ITT mark to describe an instantaneous event with a message
create_range_context: create a context manager range that pushes and pops ITT ranges automatically
